t: After a falling out with family
a: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِأَخِى وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِى رَحْمَتِكَ ۖ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
p: Rabbi-ghfir lī wa li-akhī wa adkhilnā fī raḥmatik, wa anta arḥamu-r-rāḥimīn.
m: [Moses] said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
